items.detail: United States teammates Sergiño Dest and Ricardo Pepi combined for the winning goal to give PSV Eindhoven their first victory of the Dutch league season on Saturday.

items.headline: 👕 New Man Utd kit inspired by iconic local club
items.detail: Manchester United's 2026-27 third kit is a stylish jersey in ivory, burgundy and dark green -- similar colors to the famous Salford Lads and Girls Club.

items.headline: Is Malawi's WAFCON run the most remarkable major tournament performance ever?
items.detail: Malawi, ranked 153rd in the world, have reached the 2026 WAFCON Final in their tournament debut.
